E1.note: Two blocks. With box moves the boxes are always complete, so a box term would always be 0 (weighted = missing_rc there, not run twice). With one-cell changes the loss must count boxes, so missing_rc is not allowed.

E2.note: A swap inside a box can't repair a random fill, so random init only appears with one-cell changes.

E3.note: 'chain' = steps per temperature; 'auto' T0 = std dev of 200 sample move deltas. The baseline's reheat stays on, so a reheat returns T to the T0 under test.

E4.note: Same budget for all: 1,000,000 steps. 'Stuck' = no new best loss for that many steps. A restart starts again from a new random box fill; a reheat sets T back to T0 and keeps the grid. 'alpha fit' cools from T0 to T0/100 over exactly the budget. Random-restart hill climbing is SA with the temperature at 0 (only moves that are no worse, sideways included), restarting after 2,000 steps without a new best; it is the same control as in E8.
configs: one long run, alpha fit to budget
random-restart hill climbing (T=0, restart after 2k steps stuck)

E5.note: Best setup = the config with the highest solve rate over all levels in E1-E4 (ties: lower median steps): E2: propagate / missing_rc / swap, i.e. `missing_rc propagate swap T0=auto alpha=0.99 chain=100 reheat@20000`, budget 1,000,000 steps. For comparison, random-restart hill climbing (SA at temperature 0, restarting after 2,000 steps without a new best, as in E4) runs on the same puzzles and seeds with the same 1,000,000-step budget.

E6.note: Every method gets 10 s of wall-clock time per run. SA and GA use several seeds; DFS and BFS are deterministic (one run). BFS stops when its frontier passes 2,000,000 states (~240 MB), standing in for running out of memory. Random-restart hill climbing is SA at temperature 0, restarting after 2,000 steps without a new best (the same control as in E4 and E8). 'extreme' = puzzles/extreme.txt (E6 and E8 only). A time budget makes the stopping point depend on machine speed, so a rerun with the same seed follows the same path but may stop a little earlier or later.

E8.note: Every config gets 10 s per run, as in E6. 'LS steps' = SA moves of local search applied to every new grid, at temperature 0 (only moves that are no worse). 'No crossover': children are mutated copies of tournament winners, then local search, so selection and local search without crossover. 'Random-restart hill climbing': no population at all; the same temperature-0 moves on one grid, restarting from a new box fill after 2,000 steps without a new best.
